How working with us works

A straightforward, transparent process. You always know what we are reviewing, what we recommend, and why.

Step One

Discovery Consultation

We start with a conversation about your business, your goals, and the challenges in front of you. No jargon, no pressure — just listening and honest questions.

Step Two

Financial Review

With your permission, we review your financial documents and current position to understand the full picture — income, expenses, obligations, and opportunities.

Step Three

Strategy & Roadmap

You receive a clear, written plan: priorities in order, practical steps, and timelines — explained in plain language so every decision is one you understand.

Step Four

Support & Check-Ins

We stay in your corner as you put the plan into motion, with scheduled check-ins to measure progress and adjust the strategy as your situation evolves.

About Olympus Empire Group

Olympus Empire Group is a financial consulting firm based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. We work with business owners, entrepreneurs, and individuals who want more than generic advice — they want a clear understanding of their financial position and a practical plan for what comes next.

Our consulting covers the fundamentals that decide whether a business thrives: financial planning, cash flow management, budgeting, funding readiness, and growth strategy. Every recommendation is explained in plain language, because a plan only works when the person following it understands it.

We are a consulting firm — not a bank or a lender. That independence means our guidance is built around your goals and your numbers, and we help you prepare thoroughly for whatever financial decisions you make.

Frequently asked questions

What does a financial consultant do?

A financial consultant reviews your financial position, helps you understand it clearly, and builds a practical plan around your goals. At Olympus Empire Group, that includes business financial planning, cash flow and budgeting guidance, funding readiness preparation, and growth strategy.

What happens during the first consultation?

The first consultation is a conversation. We learn about your business or personal goals, discuss your current financial situation, and identify the areas where consulting can help most. From there, we outline what a full engagement would look like — you decide whether to move forward.

Do you work with brand-new businesses?

Yes. Many of our clients come to us at the very beginning. Building sound financial structure early — budgets, bookkeeping habits, and a funding plan — saves significant time and money later.

Are you a lender? Can you guarantee funding?

No. Olympus Empire Group is a consulting firm, not a bank or lender, and we do not guarantee funding, loan approval, or any specific financial outcome. What we do is help you prepare: organizing your documentation, strengthening your financial presentation, and understanding what funding partners typically evaluate.

What should I bring to my consultation?

Bring whatever gives a picture of your finances: recent financial statements or bank statements, a summary of monthly income and expenses, and a list of your goals and questions. If you are just starting out, bring your ideas — we will work from there.

Do you meet with clients remotely?

Yes. We are based in Philadelphia and meet local clients in person by appointment, and we work with clients across the United States by phone and video call.
